newsitem.title: USA: Saga Q4 pre-booked revenue ahead of yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Saga Q4 pre-booked revenue ahead of yr-ago.

text.p: Saga Communications Inc, a broadcasting company, said pre-booked revenue for the fourth quarter as of October 25 was more than 30 percent ahead of pre-booked revenue of a year ago.
On a same-station basis, Saga said pre-booked revenues, which reflect advertising that is committed to in advance, were up 16 percent.
"We are pleased with operating indicators thus far through the fourth quarter," Saga Chairman Ed Christian said in a statement.
Saga, which owns, operates or has agreements to acquire 34 radio stations and one television station, earlier reported third quarter earnings of $0.13 a share, compared with $0.14 a year ago.
